gloss: serving food; setting out dishes; waiting at table

definitions.gloss: serving food; setting out dishes; waiting at table
definitions.explanation: The act of arranging prepared dishes on a tray or table and bringing them to diners. Used in restaurants, banquets, hospitals, and traditional inns.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{配膳|はいぜん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配膳|はいぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}った→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: I helped serve the food at the banquet.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{配膳|はいぜん}⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んで→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: At this restaurant, a serving robot brings the dishes to your table.

notes:
Refers to setting out and delivering dishes to diners. It covers both the arrangement of the food and the act of carrying it to the table. Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb {配膳|はいぜん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{配膳|はいぜん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to serve the dishes
- {配膳|はいぜん}⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧: food-serving robot
- {配膳|はいぜん}{係|がかり}: serving staff; waiter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{給仕|きゅうじ}→給仕：18148_kyuuji⟧: waiting on; serving — emphasizes attending to diners throughout the meal
- ⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}け→盛り付け：05754_moritsuke⟧: plating — arranging food attractively on the plate, before it is served
